acceptance_criteria: The tracedecay-memory-fabric crate compiles independently and depends only on tracedecay-memory-provider-api, with no TraceDecay database, code-index, root-daemon, transport, or concrete-provider dependency.

Registration, selection, and routing are driven by stable provider identity, exact registration revision, declared capabilities, explicit Disabled/Observer/Active modes, and typed fail-closed errors; no provider-name conditional or fallback exists.

Every call is admitted through finite registry and concurrency limits plus live deadline/cancellation preflight, and no queue, background task, global singleton, or unbounded async work is introduced.

Observer delivery accepts only observation.accept.v1 and returns a structurally isolated receipt with no result payload or extension channel into product context, while observer recall is rejected before provider contact.
close_reason: Added the independently compiling capability-driven memory fabric with bounded registration/concurrency, exact revision/capability routing, typed request preflight, active/observer separation, and no provider-specific or TraceDecay-internal coupling.
close_comment: Evidence: crates/tracedecay-memory-fabric depends only on tracedecay-memory-provider-api and implements finite FabricConfig, typed FabricError, stable registration state, deterministic provider status, lock-free bounded call permits, exact revision and capability checks, cancellation/deadline preflight, compatible handshake validation, active invocation, and observation-only delivery. ObserverReceipt intentionally strips provider payloads/extensions so observer values are unreachable from context by type. No worker, queue, transport, persistence, DB/code-index/daemon/host dependency, global singleton, provider-name conditional, or fallback exists. Strict Rust tests cover bounded/duplicate/mismatched registration, capability-driven active calls, missing optional capability, structural observer isolation, disabled/revision failures before provider contact, cancellation/deadline non-contact, deterministic ordering, and finite concurrent permits. Workspace/lock wiring is generated and convergence-mapped; product ownership policy and checker recognize the additive fabric crate. Metadata, fmt, Clippy -D warnings, tests, provider API regression, M1 binding drift, patch budget, dependency graph, and concrete-provider scanner all pass.
